## Highlights

- **No more stalled updates.** The integration handles the MyGekko rate limit (HTTP 429) gracefully: only one request per poll, automatic back-off, entities keep their values, configurable update interval and a repair hint if the limit persists.
- **Independent of external libraries.** Own API layer (derived from PyMyGekko, MIT), with timeouts and tolerant parsing.
- **New devices and entities:** energy manager, wallbox, heating circuits and systems, alarm system (read only), multiroom audio, SMS/e-mail, trends, doors and gates (read only), binary sensors, floor temperature, heating/cooling action of room controllers.
- **Better device model:** controller device, optional areas from MyGekko pages, `element_status` attribute, diagnostics download, icons and translations (en, de, fr, it, nb), brand images.
- **Configuration:** options (update interval, areas), re-authentication, reconfigure.
- **Home Assistant 2026.8 to 2026.11:** tested on 2026.8, 2026.10 and the development version of 2026.11; uses the matching temperature API automatically.

## Breaking changes

- **Climate presets** are now `off`, `comfort`, `reduced`, `manual`, `standby` (before `1`, `8`, `16`, `64`, `256`). Update automations and scripts that set or compare `preset_mode`.
- The 8 time frame energy sensors per meter are disabled by default for new installations.

## Installation

HACS: add `https://github.com/merlin2533/MyGekko` as custom repository, download, restart Home Assistant.
